query:
SELECT s.id, s.userId, s.teamId, t.name as teamName, COUNT(sp.id) as playerCount
FROM squads s
LEFT JOIN teams t ON s.teamId = t.id
LEFT JOIN squadPlayers sp ON sp.squadId = s.id
GROUP BY s.id, s.userId, s.teamId, t.name;
